composition_label: Normal research (Research) -> Semantic search (Smart product search)

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Object: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, query, products[{product_id,name,category}], sources[{source_id,product_id,title,text}], optional research_limit/search_limit (1..100), optional embedding_weight (0..1). IDs unique within their collection; source product references must resolve. Empty collections allowed.
shared_schema.output: Object: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, status=ok, research{query,findings}, semantic{query,indexed_products,ranking_mode,results}. Error object: status=error,error; CLI exits 2.
shared_schema.finding: finding_id, product_id, text (verbatim extraction), score (query-term coverage), citation
shared_schema.citation: source_id,title,start,end,quote. Zero-based Python Unicode character offsets; end exclusive; quote exactly equals source text[start:end].
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate function checks input references and types, exact research citations and extractive findings, and final result provenance against the research handoff.

cross_stage_handoffs: Research emits validated ranked extractive findings with product IDs and exact source spans.

Search accepts only validated research findings, groups those findings by product, and builds an inverted index from product name/category plus extracted passages. It does not index unretrieved source text or products.
Final results retain all finding IDs and exact citations for each indexed product. The shared output validator checks this provenance.

behavior.research: Split sentences/lines; case-fold Unicode word tokens; require at least one exact query-token match; rank by distinct query-token coverage, then source ID and character offset. Apply research_limit, default 20.
behavior.search: In-memory inverted index and BM25 (k1=1.2,b=0.75); normalize lexical scores as s/(1+s). Rank descending score, then product ID. Apply search_limit, default 10.
behavior.optional_embedding: run_pipeline(request, embedder=callable). Callable receives [query, indexed document texts in product-ID order] once and returns equal-dimension nonempty numeric vectors. Validate shape, count, finite components bounded to +/-1e100. Clamp cosine similarity to [0,1]; zero vectors yield zero. Blend lexical and embedding scores using embedding_weight (default .35). Exceptions become ValidationError. No provider implementation or CLI plugin loading.
behavior.determinism: Deterministic default behavior and tie-breaking. An injected callable must itself be deterministic for reproducible hybrid scores.
behavior.empty: No passage matches, punctuation-only queries, or an empty catalog return successful empty findings/results without calling an embedder.

included: Exact source citation offsets and cross-stage provenance
Deterministic lexical retrieval and product relevance ranking
Optional injected embedding interface tested with local fixtures
Runnable JSON CLI and standard-library unittest coverage
excluded: Live research, networks, model providers or generated claims
Enterprise persistence, web services or authentication
Semantic recall outside the lexical research candidate set
Negation understanding or factual verification; excerpts preserve original wording
Advanced sentence boundary detection, stemming, synonym expansion or learned embeddings
LLM summarization; findings are exact extracts
